reply.caption: An inspiring contemporary instrumental score featuring gentle warm strings, subtle East African pentatonic lyre accents, and delicate ambient pads. Designed as a soft background texture under narration, it evolves smoothly with no aggressive lead melody.

cues.note: Quiet ambient shimmer with delicate plucked string motif
Warm cellos enter adding subtle rhythmic forward motion
Luminous orchestral swell marking key breakthrough
Full rich texture evoking continental pride and hope
Return to soft opening motif with quiet lingering resolve
